summary: Independent exact-head review of PR #150 is NO-GO: token refresh concurrency, permission escalation handling, HTTP 403 rate-limit classification, and retry-hint timing need fixes.
validation: Findings are localized to internal/githubproject/app_token.go and client.go
blockers: Concurrent cache misses/forced refreshes can stampede and stale responses can overwrite newer tokens.
Permission validation can allow a replacement map and does not reject unexpected or elevated grants.
HTTP 403 rate-limit responses are not retried while ordinary permission denials must remain permanent.
Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Reset hints are capped at two seconds instead of being honored to the context deadline.
next_action: Return to code, implement the four bounded fixes with regression tests, then rerun independent review and exact-head checks.

issues.title: Serialize or generation-guard installation token refreshes
issues.details: Concurrent misses and forced refreshes can stampede and stale responses can overwrite a newer token.

issues.title: Enforce mandatory permission minima and reject escalation
issues.details: Configured override can replace mandatory map; returned unexpected/elevated permissions are not rejected.

issues.title: Retry rate-limit HTTP 403 only
issues.details: 403 with rate-limit evidence must be retryable; ordinary permission denial must remain permanent.

issues.title: Honor server retry hints within context
issues.details: Do not force Retry-After or reset hints down to a two-second cap; remain bounded by context and retry budget.
